disposition_reason: Lipsticks and eyeshadows brought in by residents of Morelia, Mexico, were screened by portable XRF and a subset analysed by ICP-OES; ranges, medians and extreme values for arsenic, cadmium, chromium, lead, nickel, zinc, barium, vanadium, copper and tin are printed in Tables I-III and the text.
disposition_locator: Tables I-III, pp. 422-427; Results text, pp. 419-421

study.design: market survey of citizen-supplied cosmetics in three price ranges; XRF screening (63 lipsticks, 366 eyeshadows), ICP-OES subset (5 lipsticks, 14 eyeshadows)
study.origin: not stated (many brands, some sold online)
study.market: street vendors, catalogs and department stores, Morelia, Michoacan, Mexico
study.method: portable XRF (Genius 7000); microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion with ICP-OES (Agilent 5100); XRD; SEM-EDS
lod: XRF LOD: 10 mg/kg V, Cr, Ag, Cd, Sn, Sb, Ti, Y; 5 mg/kg Mn, Fe, Cu, Pb, Ni, Zn; 2 mg/kg As, Ca, Mo, Sr, Rb. ICP-OES PQL (mg/kg): Al 5.7, As 5.7, Ba 0.6, Cd 0.6, Cr 0.6, Fe 0.6, Mn 0.6, Pb 5.7, Ti 0.6, Zn 0.57
study.qa: XRF internal reference material every 20 measurements; ICP-OES calibration with QCS-26, duplicate blanks, spikes (results not given)
